_comment: Evidence base for the ruleset: real pull-request review comments. Anonymised for publication -- repositories are opaque labels, file paths are reduced to the architectural layer the rule depends on, and domain identifiers inside the quotes are substituted for neutral equivalents. The objection each quote makes is unchanged. `id` is the review comment id and is the dedup key used by scripts/harvest.py -- never edit or invent one. Which repositories to harvest, and whose comments, live in sources.json (gitignored; see sources.example.json). Add entries only via /fran-learn.
